training: All retrieved candidates at all training cutoffs. No negative sampling, no class balancing. Each nonempty customer-month query has total row weight 1; zero-purchase queries remain all-negative examples.
selection: Choose highest pooled validation query-macro NDCG@10; ties use configuration order. Fit training only, fixed iteration counts, no early stopping or random row splits. At most these three predefined XGBoost fits.
scores: Logistic decision_function and XGBoost raw margins are ranking scores, not calibrated purchase probabilities. Descending score, ascending normalized SKU resolves ties.
segment_boundaries: Frequency uses lifetime distinct purchase invoices from snapshots; inclusive integer bounds. Recency uses lifetime last-purchase age: first bin [0,30], then (30,90], then (90,180].

bootstrap.statistic: Pooled primary-query mean paired NDCG@10 difference; resample customers with replacement and retain every primary query for each drawn customer.

advance.scope: Validation-only advancement recommendation; interval is descriptive and selection uses the same validation data. No test evaluation or deployment.

tracking: Structured local JSON manifests; no hosted tracking service. Test partitions and paid rows at/after 2011-05-01 are not loaded.
